title: Select the pertussis model activates the partial-immunity structure
expected: Model switches to pertussis; the pertussis-only 'Observed data & calibration' panel becomes available.
actual: Pertussis selected; pertussis-only calibration panel present.

title: Model-parameters panel exposes all pertussis parameters
expected: R0, incubation, naive & partial infectious periods, sigma, delta, three waning terms (omega1/2/3) and seasonality are all shown.

title: Initial-conditions expose partial-track split and coverage profile
expected: Controls for infections-in-partial-track, Sp share of the immune pool, and a saved coverage-profile selector are present.

title: Baseline scenario runs and produces trajectories
expected: Result tabs appear and the Trajectories chart shows a non-zero infection curve.

title: Partial-track infectious compartment (Ip) is available
expected: The partial-track infectious (Ip) curve is displayed.

title: Summary metrics are computed
expected: Attack rate, peak prevalence and related metrics are shown by age band.

title: DTaP/Tdap saved campaign set loads into the scenario
expected: Three DTaP/Tdap campaign lines are loaded into the scenario.

title: Observed-data overlay produces an Observed-vs-modeled comparison
pre: Lane County observed dataset selected in Overlay mode; a run has completed.
expected: Observed vs modeled vaccinated-share metrics and comparison charts are displayed.

title: Contacts-by-setting age-mixing view renders
expected: A per-age-band breakdown of contacts across home/school/work/community is shown.

title: Initial infected + background immunity over 100% is rejected
expected: A validation error states that initial infected + background immunity must be <= 100%.

title: Contact-intervention form is available
expected: Layer, Start day, End day, Reduction (%) controls and an Add button are present.

title: Add a school closure (50%) to the plan
expected: A 'school - 50% - day 0 -> 250' entry appears under 'Added contact interventions'.

title: Add an all-layers intervention
expected: An 'all - ... ' entry is added to the interventions list.

title: Remove an intervention
expected: The intervention is removed and the list updates.

title: A scenario with an intervention runs and reflects the reduction
expected: The run completes and the Contact Interventions tab shows the contact reduction over time.

title: End day earlier than start day is rejected
expected: A warning states that End day must be greater than or equal to start day; no entry is added.

title: Planner grid is pre-filled with the DTaP/Tdap schedule
expected: The age-stratified grid is pre-filled with DTaP/Tdap coverage (0-4: 92%, 5-19: 90%, adults ~7%).

title: A coverage profile can be saved and persists
pre: On the Vaccination Planner page, section 2.
expected: A confirmation states the profile was saved and will persist between sessions.

title: Saving a coverage profile with an empty name is rejected
pre: On the Vaccination Planner page, section 2.
expected: A warning states that a profile name is required; nothing is saved.
